title: Story text file
description: Every story file in game/data/story/ (except this one) is an object with schema_version 1 and either 'pieces' (in-game text for a dialogue box) or 'concepts' (design notes for later packages, never shown in game). Placeholders allowed in lines: {name} (display name, max 20), {machine} (machine title), {part} (part title), {repo_url} (Ids.REPO_URL). Pieces that share a 'group' are alternatives: show one, picked at random or in turn. tools/dev/check-story.py validates every file against this schema and also checks: ASCII only, max 3 lines per piece, max 90 characters per line with placeholders at their longest, unique ids across files, real machine and part ids, and no puzzle answers.

where.description: Screen or place: start_screen, loading, town, town:<spot>, shop, lucky_word_entry, clue_board, machine_view:<machine>, puzzle:<machine>/<part>, merge_celebration, contributors, crew_progress, settings, finale_archive, big_screen; and for the adventure layer room:<room id> (data/rooms.json) and inventory.

when.description: always; interaction (a tap or drop in the adventure layer names this piece by id, from chain or room data); hint (Red Panda's help for a chain step); first_visit (first time 'where' is shown on this device); no_crew / has_crew (player state while at 'where'); idle (no input for a while on 'where'); interval (timed, while in the town); merged (any credited merge); first_credit (the first credited solve on this device); uncredited (a revealed solve); machine_running:<machine id, or crew for the player's own crew>; part_fixed:<machine>/<part>; finale_open; note_found and handoff_solved (finale, shape set by WP9); line_running (the whole line runs end to end).

expression.description: Portrait expression in the adventure layer's dialogue bar (portrait.<speaker>.<expression> in game/assets.json). Default neutral.

dev_note.description: For the implementer; never shown to players.
